entities.title: Recording format
entities.summary: runs: [bits, count, bits, count, …], what the browser sends and the Worker replays.
consumers: src/main.ts, which records every frame of a game
guarantees: Each frame's Input is six bits: left 1, right 2, fire 4, start1 8, start2 16, pause 32
Runs are [bits, count] pairs, count a whole number of at least 1, consecutive frames with the same bits in one run
The recording starts on the frame that starts the game and ends on the frame it ended
At most 432,000 frames (two hours) and 200,000 runs
entities.compatibility: Any change to game.ts, rules.ts, rng.ts or trig.ts changes what a recording replays to. Scores already on the table are not replayed again, but a game in progress during a deploy may be refused or scored differently.
